question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 guide is $108B ±2%. NVIDIA beat the Q1 and Q2 FY27 guides by 4.6% and 5.7%, so Q3 actual is likely about $113-114B. Recent next-quarter guides have been 11.5-14.5% above the prior quarter's actual. Management said hyperscale growth should speed up again in Q4 as Vera Rubin supply grows, so I use a step-up of about 13%, giving a median near $127.5B. FY27 consensus of $411.7B implies about $124B for Q4, and NVIDIA usually guides above consensus. Risks: memory and Rubin supply limits, exports (China is already excluded from the outlook), and the margin bottoming at 71-72% in Q4, which does not directly affect revenue. No human prediction market found on the revenue guide; Polymarket and Kalshi only list EPS-beat and word-mention contracts.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 (reported late Aug 2026): revenue $96.2B (+106% y/y, +18% q/q); Data Center $89.0B; GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin 75.0% (NVIDIA press release).
- Q3 FY27 outlook: $108.0B ±2% ($105.84-110.16B); GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin 74% ±50bp; no China Data Center compute revenue assumed (press release). Q3 consensus before the guide was about $103.5-103.8B (MarketBeat / Webull).
- Q1 FY27: revenue $81.6B (+20% q/q) against a guide of $78B; the Q2 guide given then was $91B ±2%, and Q2 actual came in at $96.2B (press releases).
- Earlier guides: Q4 FY26 guide was about $65B against a Q3 FY26 actual of about $57.0B; Q1 FY27 guide of $78B came against a Q4 FY26 actual of about $68.1B (memory and press releases). Guide-to-prior-actual ratios across Q4 FY26 to Q3 FY27: about +14%, +14.5%, +11.5%, +12.3%. Beats of actual over guide: Q1 FY27 +4.6%, Q2 FY27 +5.7%.
- Q2 FY27 earnings call (Fool transcript): Q3 sequential growth driven mainly by ACIE; 'growth in hyperscale is expected to reaccelerate in Q4 and into fiscal year 28, as supply of Vera Rubin grows'; Vera Rubin about 20% of Data Center revenue in Q3; 'fastest product ramp in NVIDIA's history'.
- Same call: gross margin expected to bottom in Q4 at 71-72% because of memory pricing; FY28 revenue growth guided at about 70%, described as supply-constrained, with demand 'much higher'; about $500B in financing partnerships cited.
- Consensus: FY27 revenue average about $411.65B (54 analysts, range $403-427B) per MarketBeat/StockAnalysis-type aggregators. Minus Q1+Q2 ($177.8B) and Q3 consensus (about $108-110B) => implied Q4 consensus of about $122-126B; no direct Q4 revenue consensus figure was found.
- Status quo: NVIDIA has given a single-point revenue guide ±2% every quarter, and recently has always guided above consensus.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the Q4 FY27 revenue outlook midpoint in NVIDIA's Q3 FY27 press release (expected around Nov 18-19, 2026), not off Q3 actual revenue.
- Event window: the Q3 FY27 earnings release, expected mid-to-late Nov 2026 (scheduled resolution 2026-11-17); as of 2026-10-07 the guide has not been issued.
- Downside candidates: memory or Rubin supply bottlenecks, new export restrictions, hyperscaler capex pauses. Upside candidates: China H20/compute licenses restored and included in the guide, a faster Rubin supply ramp.
- Searched without finding: a direct Q4 FY27 revenue consensus figure, any mid-quarter guidance update, and a human prediction market on the revenue guide (only EPS-beat and word-mention markets exist).
calls.reference_class: NVIDIA next-quarter revenue guides relative to the prior quarter's actual, Q4 FY26 through Q3 FY27 (+11.5% to +14.5%), applied to an expected Q3 FY27 actual of guide plus a typical 4-6% beat

calls.reasoning: Recent guide path $78B -> $91B -> $108B, each new guide 17-19% above the previous one; continuing that gives $126-128.5B. NVIDIA has beaten the top of its guidance range 12 straight quarters (Q2 $96.2B vs $91B guide), so Q3 actual is likely $112.5-114.5B, and an 11-13% sequential guide on that gives ~$125-129B. FY27 consensus ~$411B implies a street Q4 of ~$124.5B, and NVIDIA's guides have recently come in above the street. Rubin's larger Q4 ramp and the 70% FY28 growth outlook tilt the estimate up; supply limits through FY28 cap it. No matching Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market found.

- Status quo: NVIDIA gives a quarterly next-quarter revenue guide as a point ±2% in the release. It also gave an annual FY28 outlook; whether a quarterly Q4 point guide continues has not been confirmed (no sign of a change found).
- Resolution instrument: the Q4 FY2027 revenue guide midpoint in the Q3 FY2027 earnings release (scheduled ~Nov 17-19 2026), not the actual result or analyst estimates. Resolution criteria text was blank in the prompt.
- Event window: the Q3 FY27 earnings release (expected mid/late Nov 2026). As of Oct 7 2026, Q3 (ending ~late Oct) is mostly elapsed.
- Searched for but not found: a specific Q4 consensus figure from a named provider, China/export-control updates since Aug, and a Kalshi or Polymarket market on the Q4 guide (none found).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same factual base: Q2 actual $96.2B, Q3 guide $108B, beat streak, guide ratios, FY27 consensus ~$411B implying Q4 ~$124-125B. No factual conflicts. Run 2's unverified recall of the Q1 guide ($78B) matches the other runs and is immaterial. Remaining differences are judgment: median 127.5 vs 128 and tail mass of 2-4% low / 7-8% high. I carry forward the guide-ratio reference class and a dispersion of ~11.5, between the runs' 10-13, because the ratio method combines two uncertainties: the size of the Q3 beat and the size of the step-up. Median 127.5: no evidence beyond management's 'reacceleration' remark supports a step-up above 14%, and the supply constraint argues against it.
